item.tib: phya tshe g.yang gi sgrub pa g.yung drung 'khyil pa
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ phya tshe g.yang gi sgrub pa/ phya g.yang gter gyi bang mdzod dmu zhag bcud kyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ rim par brgyud nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkhas yang gsang gnad kyi lde mig khol du phyung ba 'di ra sang khod ram la gdams so/ de nas nges med rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub tu bab (babs) pa'o//
